title: Router on a stick
intro: Hillview Library, part two. Staff are on VLAN 10 (10.0.10.0/24) and guests on VLAN 20 (10.0.20.0/24). One cable joins the switch to the router, and the router should route for both VLANs. Nobody can get online yet.

tasks.text: Make the cable to the router a trunk carrying VLANs 10 and 20
tasks.hint: sw1: interface fa0/1, switchport mode trunk, switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20

tasks.text: Give the router a gateway for VLAN 20: g0/0.20, 10.0.20.1/24
tasks.hint: r1's console: enable, configure terminal, interface g0/0.20, encapsulation dot1Q 20, ip address 10.0.20.1 255.255.255.0

tasks.text: guest1 gets online but guest2 doesn't. Find out why and fix it
tasks.hint: Compare ip route on both. guest2's gateway is 10.0.20.254, and nothing has that address.

tasks.text: Guests reach websites but not staff PCs
tasks.hint: r1, Firewall rules: zone staff 10.0.10.0/24, zone guest 10.0.20.0/24, zone internet any, allow any staff -> any, allow tcp guest -> internet:80,443, deny any guest -> staff, default deny
